import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
u = u.merge(c, on='instance_type', suffixes=('','_cur'))
u['required_vcpu'] = u['vcpu_cur']*u['p95_cpu_pct']/100/0.7
u['required_mem'] = u['memory_gib_cur']*u['p95_mem_pct']/100/0.8

def rec(row):
    fam = row['family']
    cand = c[(c.family==fam) & (c.vcpu>=row.required_vcpu) & (c.memory_gib>=row.required_mem)]
    if cand.empty:
        return row['instance_type']
    return cand.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0]['instance_type']

u['rec_type'] = u.apply(rec, axis=1)
u = u.merge(c[['instance_type','hourly_usd']].rename(columns={'hourly_usd':'rec_hourly'}), on='rec_type')
u['cur_hourly'] = u['hourly_usd']  # wait, hourly_usd is current
# careful: after merges, 'hourly_usd' col is from first merge (current). rec_hourly from last.
bad = u[u['rec_hourly'] > u['hourly_usd']]
print(bad[['instance_id','instance_type','rec_type','hourly_usd','rec_hourly']])
print(list(bad.instance_id))

    cand = c[(c.family==row.family)&(c.vcpu>=row.required_vcpu)&(c.memory_gib>=row.required_mem)]
